categories.name: Education
categories.description: Schools, colleges, universities, scholarships, teachers, examinations, admissions and mid-day meal programmes.
examples: Details of scholarship funds disbursed to students of government schools
Teacher vacancies and recruitment in a government college

categories.name: Healthcare
categories.description: Hospitals, clinics, doctors, medicines, vaccination, ambulances and public health programmes.
examples: Availability of essential medicines at the district hospital
Number of ambulances deployed and their response times

categories.name: Transportation
categories.description: Public buses, road permits, driving licences, vehicle registration, traffic management and public transit.
examples: Bus route changes and fare revisions in the city
Driving licence applications pending beyond the prescribed time

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.description: Roads, bridges, buildings, public works, construction contracts and tenders.
examples: Tender and contractor details for the bridge construction project
Budget spent on repairing a state highway

categories.name: Public administration
categories.description: Government offices, recruitment, service rules, transfers, files, certificates and administrative procedures.
examples: Status of a grievance filed with a government office
Number of vacant posts and the recruitment timeline

categories.name: Electricity
categories.description: Power supply, electricity bills, connections, meters, outages, transformers and power utilities.
examples: Power outage hours recorded in a rural feeder last year
Procedure and delay in sanctioning a new electricity connection

categories.name: Water supply
categories.description: Drinking water, pipelines, borewells, water quality, sewage connections and water boards.
examples: Water quality test reports for drinking water in the ward
Pipeline repair work and tanker supply schedule

categories.name: Agriculture
categories.description: Farmers, crops, irrigation, subsidies, seeds, fertilisers, crop insurance and procurement.
examples: Crop insurance claims settled for farmers in the district

categories.name: Municipal services
categories.description: Garbage collection, sanitation, street lights, property tax, parks, building permissions and local civic services.
examples: Garbage collection schedule and complaints in the ward
Street lights installed and maintenance expenditure

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Requests that do not clearly belong to any other category.
